root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward something whose point of access, means of approach, or manner of comprehension is not apparent.
root_idea.development: This orientation develops into meanings of closure, obscurity, solidity, and formidable inaccessibility. Related lexical branches include a single unmixed color, beasts and young animals, a plant, and the thumb, some of which are treated as specialized departures from the central pattern.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun بَهِيمَة is a distinct lexical item and is displayed under its normalized citation form.

senses.definition: A beast or animal; in the Quranic expression بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ, a beast of the livestock kind.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the genitive construction بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ. In established usage, بَهِيمَة generally denotes an animal without articulate speech and is conventionally distinguished from predatory animals and birds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate lambs or kids from their mothers and pasture them separately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stay or remain in a place without leaving it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II verb, used with بِالمكانِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To continue looking at something fixedly without finding relief in the act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form II use said of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become silent and perplexed when questioned about something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form II use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain from fighting or engaging in conflict.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form II use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dubious, confused, or vague, so that the way to understand or deal with something is unknown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form IV use, said of a thing or affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To close, lock, or stop up a door; of the thumb, to close over the palm of the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV physical-closure construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing, speech, report, or information dubious, confused, vague, or difficult to understand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form IV use, contrary to making something clear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To declare or treat something as absolutely prohibited and impermissible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV use applied to a prohibited matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a person turn away, withdraw, or retire from a thing or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV construction with عَنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to produce or abound in بُهْمَى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV use describing vegetation produced by the land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be as though an affair, speech, or information were closed against someone, making it difficult or impossible to understand, express, or carry out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X construction, especially استبهم عليه الأمر or الكلام; it may describe an impeded or tongue-tied speaker or obscure information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Young sheep, goats, or young animals of the bovine kind; a lamb or kid in the relevant early stage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reports differ on whether the term applies immediately after birth or after the stage called سَخْلَةٌ, and on its precise age range.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lunar mansion called Saʿd al-Bihām; alternatively, two stars not counted among the lunar mansions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper astronomical designation with variant descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, abounding in the plant called بُهْمَى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possessive adjective applied to land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A solid rock or great mass of stone, without a hollow interior.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun; the sense extends to something solid and impenetrable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A courageous, formidable man or horseman difficult for an adversary to approach, or a resolute man who is not turned from what he intends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative epithet; the cited lexical restriction excludes its use as an epithet for a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An army, or a company of courageous or armored horsemen difficult to engage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or plural-like use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A difficult, baffling, or embarrassing affair whose management or solution is not apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative noun; its plural may describe dubious or confused affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blackness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract or color-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The three nights in which the moon does not visibly rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional calendrical or astronomical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prickly grass or pasture plant, eagerly eaten by sheep, goats, or camels while green and becoming thorny when dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name used as both a singular and collective noun in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black; also, a black ewe with no white marking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may be substantivized for the ewe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of one pure, unmixed color, with no contrasting color in it, whether black or another color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a horse or to a color; the cited authorities except the color termed شُهْبَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A night without light until dawn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective applied to night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sound or voice, without trilling, quavering, or reiteration in the throat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Whole and sound, without mutilation, defect, or disease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One interpretation of the expression يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ بُهْمًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Naked, without anything covering the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the expression يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ بُهْمًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Without worldly goods or commodities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the expression يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ بُهْمًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unknown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use attributed to a cited authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of, or relating to, beasts or brute animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Relational adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The nature or essential character of beasts or brute animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Abstract noun derived from the relational adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mute or unable to articulate speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical equivalent of أَعْجَم in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thumb or great toe, the largest digit of the hand or foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is feminine in common usage but is also attested as masculine; its regular plurals include أَبَاهِيمُ and أَبَاهِمُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Closed or inaccessible; of a door, locked or stopped up; of a wall, without a door; or of a chest, without a means of opening it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial adjective describing physical absence of an opening or access.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Solid and without a fissure or hollow; figuratively, of a heart, impervious to admonition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical and associated figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obscure, vague, indefinite, or difficult to understand; of a road, unapparent or hardly apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to things, speech, information, legal ordinances, and, in grammatical terminology, demonstrative nouns and certain particles whose derivation or root is not apparent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a vow or an ordinance concerning marriage, divorce, or emancipation, inescapable or impossible to extricate oneself from.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative legal use, conceived as a closed door with a lock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Absolutely prohibited and not allowable under any circumstance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to prohibited matters, including certain permanently forbidden marriages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a state of swooning or insensibility, speechless and without discrimination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or resultant-state use, especially after a blow or similar affliction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Debarred from the faculty of speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنِ الكلامِ for a person unable to speak.

cautions: The Classical definition of بَهْمٌ varies among authorities as to the precise age and stage of lambs or kids.

The interpretations of بُهْمًا in the cited eschatological expression vary between bodily wholeness, nakedness, and absence of worldly possessions; these are retained as distinct Classical interpretations rather than treated as Quranic senses.
